items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: Willie took a break and chucked that Charlie Moore and knocked a picket fence down.

ctx.x: Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm.

Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Jack Carey, Ben Ben Matthews playing the drum, Charlie Moore, one of his old friends. Yeah, he's right. We played at a hall one night, they called Nelta's Hall. And then Charlie Moore got in the humbug and look, when they got outside, Willie took a break and chucked that Charlie Moore and knocked a picket fence down.
